title: G-0006 daily budget tracker for Opus tier
body_md: G-0006 sets a $10/day cap on Opus 4.7 synthesis. profiles/<role>.json declares daily_budget_usd but nothing enforces it. Add src/budget/tracker.ts: read per-role budget from profile, log claim+model+est-cost to a daily ledger event row, refuse new claims for that role when day's spend exceeds budget. Use prompt-token counts × Anthropic pricing for estimation.
acceptance_md: bun test src/budget/tracker.test.ts; (a) tracks spend per-role, (b) blocks new claim when over budget, (c) resets at UTC midnight.
evidence_md: src/budget/tracker.ts + tracker.test.ts (11 pass / 0 fail). Implements G-0006: PRICING table per model; logClaimCost writes note events tagged budget; spendForRoleToday sums UTC-day spend per role; checkBudget gates by profile.daily_budget_usd; claimIfBudget wraps claim SQL and emits budget-blocked event when over. Acceptance (a/b/c) covered by tests. Follow-up: wire claimIfBudget into factory/worker-shell. PR #22.
